All 5 files are in place. Here is a summary of what was created:

---

**Files created:**

1. `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Shopify App/QuizSnap/app/routes/app.templates.tsx` (16 KB)
   - Loader fetches custom templates (shop-scoped) and global templates in parallel via `Promise.all`
   - Action handles `use-template` intent: finds template, increments `usageCount`, generates a unique slug, creates a draft quiz, then redirects to the quiz builder
   - When `globalTemplates` is empty (fresh install), falls back to 6 hardcoded template cards that route to `/app/quizzes/new`
   - Custom template empty state uses Polaris `EmptyState` with a "Save your own templates" message
   - `InlineGrid` with 3-column responsive layout; template cards use Polaris CSS design tokens (`var(--p-color-border)`, `var(--p-border-radius-300)`)
   - `HydrateFallback` with `SkeletonPage`, `headers` using `boundary.headers` — matches the billing route pattern exactly

2. `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Shopify App/QuizSnap/app/routes/app.quizzes.$id.analytics.tsx` (11 KB)
   - Loader verifies quiz ownership via `{ id, shop: session.shop }` before any data access
   - Computes `totalResponses`, `completedResponses`, `completionRate`, and `avgScore` (separate aggregate query only runs if there are completed responses)
   - Date range selector (`Select`) uses `useNavigate` to append `?days=X` without a form submission
   - 4-column `InlineGrid` stat cards (`StatCard` helper component), then an `IndexTable` for recent responses
   - Email column shows `"Anonymous"` when null; status column uses `Badge tone="success"` for completed and `"warning"` for in-progress
   - Install banner shown only when `quiz.startCount === 0 && totalResponses === 0`
   - `HydrateFallback` + `boundary.headers` present

3. `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Shopify App/QuizSnap/app/components/shared/ConfirmModal.tsx`
   - Polaris `Modal` with configurable title, message, confirm label, and `destructive` flag

4. `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Shopify App/QuizSnap/app/components/shared/PlanGate.tsx`
   - Imports `PlanId` from `~/utils/constants`; uses `PLAN_ORDER` index comparison to determine access; renders an upgrade prompt card with a link to `/app/billing` when blocked

5. `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Shopify App/QuizSnap/app/components/shared/PageSkeleton.tsx`
   - Two-section skeleton layout using `SkeletonPage`, `SkeletonDisplayText`, and `SkeletonBodyText`

All files use strict TypeScript (no `any`), follow the `authenticate.admin` first / shop-scoped query pattern from the existing routes, and import `db` from `~/db.server` with `authenticate` from `../shopify.server`.
